name: The Up Here
source:
Jean Walnutte, a depressed chipmunk writing a history book, has checked herself into a high-end resort called The Up Here to finish her manuscript but finds herself plagued by an existential crisis that causes extreme dizziness. Can she survive the dark corridors of her own tiny mind?

The self-hating lovechild of Jean-Paul Sartre and Wes Anderson, The Up Here is, well… it just is, and beyond that it can guarantee nothing. Enjoy choosing whether to play this game or not. 

I, for one, would not.

[From [url=https://rosebehar.itch.io/the-up-here]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
吉恩·沃尔纳特 (Jean Walnutte) 是一只正在写历史书的抑郁花栗鼠，她入住一家名为“The Up Here”的高端度假村来完成她的手稿，但发现自己陷入了一场导致极度头晕的生存危机。她能在自己小小的心灵的黑暗走廊里生存下来吗？

作为让·保罗·萨特和韦斯·安德森的自我憎恨的私生子，《这里》是，嗯……它就是这样，除此之外它不能保证任何东西。享受选择是否玩这个游戏的乐趣。

就我而言，我不会。

[来自[url=https://rosebehar.itch.io/the-up-here]Itch.io[/url]]
